question: Does causally observed approach depth of an expired unfilled Passive limit separate the native stressed outcomes of later same-direction Return or Cross lifecycles broadly and strongly enough to justify one later entry-preserving selector experiment?

frozen_parent.copy_rule: One-time self-contained copy into this family; no cross-family Include, link or execution dependency.

excluded_sources: Pre-Next repositories, names, experiments and conclusions
current Live-Dev source, state, logs, terminal and broker state
closed receiver-time-field source as an implementation dependency

frozen_source_and_config.manifest_algorithm: Sort source-root-relative forward-slash paths, uppercase each file SHA-256, join path|hash with LF, then SHA-256 UTF-8.
frozen_source_and_config.compile_defect_rule: A compile-only correction is allowed before any market outcome is opened, must be documented, and requires new frozen manifests. No source or config change is allowed after the first real-tick outcome is opened.

pre_outcome_refreeze.reason: The authoritative Tester evidence contract requires start/end US30, US100 and US500 contract and swap fields in addition to symbols-*.dat hashes.

unchanged: all six signal formulas, decision times and opportunity consumption
all order types, entry prices, volumes and expiry times
all initial stop construction, RC4 compression and native exits
margin, sizing, session clock, calendar and transaction ordering
every Return and Cross entry and native hold
economic_invariance_contract.observer_side_effects: In-memory measurement and PrintFormat telemetry only. Measurement failure never blocks, closes, places, modifies or cancels an order and never changes persisted economic state.

causal_observation.pending_birth: Begin only after one owned Passive pending order has been authoritatively adopted, using its direction, limit, feature, placement server time and scheduled expiration.
causal_observation.sampling_clock: On every US30 chart real tick, read the latest causally available US100 SymbolInfoTick and accept it only when its time_msc is strictly newer than the prior accepted US100 quote.
causal_observation.sampling_limit: This is the deployable portfolio observation stream, not a claim to exhaust every independent US100 tick between US30 chart ticks.
causal_observation.expired_emitter_birth: Create an emitter only when the disappeared owned order is found in history with ORDER_STATE_EXPIRED. Filled, partial, canceled or anomalous outcomes never emit.
causal_observation.approach_fraction: clamp(1 - minimum executable gap / initial executable gap, 0, 1)
causal_observation.rebound_fraction: max((final executable gap - minimum executable gap) / initial executable gap, 0)
causal_observation.nearest_time_fraction: clamp((nearest quote time - placement server time) / (scheduled expiration - placement server time), 0, 1)
causal_observation.receiver_match: For each admitted native Return or Cross lifecycle, select only the most recent same-direction emitter whose actual observation server second is strictly earlier than entry and no more than 2880 minutes old.
causal_observation.receiver_outcome: Use the lifecycle actual and stressed net already produced by frozen CP2 exit reconciliation; no future value is available at entry.

fixed_depth_bins.use: Only SHALLOW and DEEP are primary economic tails. MIDDLE, rebound and nearest-time are descriptive and cannot rescue a failed depth gate.

fixed_operational_gate: All four runs exit normally with one STOP and zero safety, persistence, broker, foreign, protection, ownership or measurement fault.
Every report exactly matches its frozen CP2 target for actual net, stressed net, stressed maximum closed drawdown, trades, deals, risk admission skips and stop-loss exits.
Every expected Passive expiration has exactly one valid RFD_EXPIRE row and no non-expired pending outcome emits.

Every admitted Return or Cross lifecycle adopted by the observer has exactly one reconciled RFD_RECEIVER close row, except a position still legitimately open at the test end, which invalidates that row but not portfolio equivalence.

requirements: At least 20 matched closed lifecycles pooled.
At least 8 SHALLOW and 8 DEEP matched closed lifecycles pooled, with each tail represented in at least three periods.
Absolute pooled Spearman correlation between approach_fraction and native stressed_net is at least 0.20.
Among periods with at least five matched lifecycles and nonconstant depth, at least three period correlations share the pooled sign.
Absolute pooled DEEP minus SHALLOW mean native stressed_net is at least USD 0.25 per lifecycle.
Among periods containing both tails, at least three period DEEP-minus-SHALLOW mean differences share the pooled sign.
fixed_information_value_gate.selection: If exactly one receiver passes, retain that receiver for one later entry-preserving selector experiment. If both pass, retain only the receiver with larger absolute pooled Spearman correlation; ties choose larger absolute tail mean difference. Otherwise retain frozen CP2 with no selector candidate.

stop_rules: Do not add a fifth run, another period, another matching horizon or another depth threshold.
Do not let rebound, nearest-time, MIDDLE-bin behavior or an unmatched comparison rescue a failed primary depth gate.
Do not change any portfolio behavior or reopen receiver-time-field-generalization-v1.
Do not implement the later selector inside this unit even if the information gate passes.
Do not alter, query or restart Live.
